records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in revenue was primarily driven by higher volume in IET on Gas Technology Equipment project backlog execution and stronger activity in OFSE.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We also achieved significant growth in new energy orders compared to 2022 as we continue to experience growing demand for decarbonization solutions across the Company's IET and OFSE portfolios.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Overall, we capitalized on market tailwinds to deliver strong revenue growth across both segments, began realizing the full benefits of our cost-out initiatives, and continued to transform how we operate.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in income before tax was driven by higher volume and price in both segments and structural cost-out initiatives, positive effect from the change in fair value on certain equity securities, and lower restructuring and impairment charges.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Total segment operating income increased $719 million, primarily driven by OFSE and to a lesser extent IET.
